description: An autonomous SRE watchdog bot that monitors container logs, performs incident deduplication, creates ServiceNow incidents, performs RCA using Mistral AI, and closes/resolves incidents.
instructions:
Build an autonomous SRE watchdog bot with the following workflow: 1. Target Container: Monitor logs for container 'devops-vsp-sample-app' for ERROR or EXCEPTION. 2. Error Extraction: When an error is detected, strip and isolate only the specific error log block and stack trace. 3. Incident Deduplication: Query ServiceNow for any active open incident with short description containing 'Application devops-vsp-sample-app Error'. If an open ticket already exists, skip ticket creation. 4. Ticket Creation: If no open ticket exists, create a ServiceNow incident with: - short_description: "Application devops-vsp-sample-app Error" - work_notes: "SRE AI agent is analyzing the issue.

=== STRIPPED ERROR LOG ===
" + stripped error - urgency: "2", impact: "2" 5. RCA Diagnostics: Send the stripped error log along with Jenkins job 'devops-vsp-pipeline' and GitHub repo 'https://github.com/shakilmunavary/devops-vsp-sample-app.git' to Mistral AI to perform a Root Cause Analysis (RCA). 6. Worker Notes & Closure: Update the same ServiceNow ticket's work_notes with the full Mistral RCA findings (Root Cause, Affected Component, Recommended Fix) and close/resolve the incident (state: 6, close_code: "Solution Provided"). 7. Continuous Schedule: Review logs every 5 seconds.
name: SRE Watchdog Bot

workflow_steps.action: Diagnose failure with Mistral AI RCA
Create ServiceNow Incident with stripped error
